description:
Refine PR 2 connection-editor UX with shared Main and Advanced settings tabs. Work in ../zaq-feat-channel-file-settings on feat/channel-file-settings, stacked on feat/email-capabilities. This is part of zaq-h2i.3, not a separate delivery feature.

Scope and acceptance
- Use one reusable tab layout and consistent advanced-section presentation across the generic channel editor and SMTP configuration form. Inspect the existing DesignSystem.TabNav, streamed-message update controls, file-delivery component, and their Storybook patterns before creating components. Reuse or extend existing patterns rather than duplicating containers per provider.
- Main holds connection details, credentials, and primary configuration. Advanced settings groups applicable streamed-message updates, File delivery, and existing advanced controls without losing or duplicating fields. Inventory current fields and record placement before editing; keep unrelated forms outside scope.
- Determine advanced-section applicability from established capabilities and supported editor operations, not provider-name cases in shared UI. Hide the Advanced settings tab only when no sections apply.
- The shared container owns presentation, accessible tab interaction, headings, spacing, and section composition. Streamed-update and file-delivery components retain their focused field responsibilities. Parent forms retain capability loading, drafts, changesets, validation, and persistence. Do not duplicate domain logic in the container.
- Switching tabs preserves every unsaved value, including file limits, explicit false policies, and credentials; tab switching itself causes no save or runtime update. Preserve form submission semantics for controls in inactive panels.
- One Save action validates and persists the whole form through existing operations. Errors on an inactive tab mark that tab and select the relevant tab so errors are visible. Preserve all drafts after rejection, including when both tabs contain errors. Define deterministic error-tab selection.
- Keep keyboard/focus behavior and ARIA semantics consistent with the established tab component. Main is the initial tab unless an established error/deep-link flow requires otherwise.
- Keep the existing capability contract, TransportRequirements struct/resolver, and both reviewed persistence fixes unchanged. No adapter, delivery, or dependency work in this issue.

Reuse and implementation planning
Read AGENTS.md, DESIGN.md, docs/bo-components.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable workflow/design instructions. Read relevant module docs and inspect existing tab/section components and form handlers before proposing the smallest composition change. Action reuse assessment: extend presentation and orchestration around existing configuration-save operations; introduce no new business Action or endpoint. Record existing save boundaries, draft ownership, and any missing prerequisites before coding. Any necessary change to save semantics needs a separately explained plan; do not weaken atomicity or authorization for tab composition.

Tests and validation
Use TDD with original focused tests, preferably in existing owning LiveView/component suites with reused fixtures/setup. Create a test module only when no existing suite is a cohesive fit. Cover applicable/hidden tabs, draft preservation over repeated switches, inactive-panel submission, validation errors on either/both tabs, explicit false values, save/reload, and unchanged settings after rejected saves. Preserve existing assertions and obtain approval before changing existing test expectations. Update relevant Storybook stories. Run issue-level checks and targeted regression suites, then update the pending UX approval and consolidated E2E scenarios to the completed tabbed interface. Do not author new feature E2E before explicit final UX approval.

Do not restart mix precommit, commit, push or publish without authorization. Record actual validation and remaining gates. This issue must precede human UX approval zaq-h2i.3.4 and therefore consolidated E2E zaq-h2i.3.5.

comments.text: Discovery and implementation plan: extend existing DesignSystem.TabNav (existing owning component tests/story), not a new tab implementation. Existing TabNav has click styling but no panel ARIA/keyboard contract; add opt-in identified tablists/panel relationships with a colocated hook and reuse the same navigation in a settings composition. This is new composition, not extraction or a styling migration; final UX gate remains zaq-h2i.3.4. Field inventory before editing: generic Main = name, instance URL, bot token, credential selector/creation/OAuth claim, bot username/user ID, enabled, provider/kind hidden routing. Generic Advanced = existing streamed updates only where the editor currently supports grouped policy saving (existing retrieval edit), plus File delivery iff established FileSettings capability visibility permits. SMTP Main = configuration name, relay, port, TLS, username/password, From name/email. SMTP Advanced = File delivery iff capability-visible, plus existing transport mode, TLS verification, CA certificate path and security warnings. Activate/test/capabilities/other forms stay outside scope. Container owns tab/panel/section presentation only; parents own capability reads, drafts, errors and save operations. Reuse existing NodeRouter/Event configuration boundaries: ChannelConfigPersistence, manage_live_update_settings grouped transaction, manage_email_connector_settings. No new Action or endpoint; no capability, adapter, resolver, issue 1 or reviewed persistence changes. Keep inactive controls mounted/enabled, change only active-tab presentation on switches, and prevent tab buttons submitting. Route rejection deterministically to Main if it has errors, otherwise Advanced; mark both when needed and retain submit drafts. Disable native form prevalidation only in these two whole-form editors so hidden invalid numeric/required controls cannot block the authoritative server changeset or prevent selecting its error tab; all existing server validations and atomic saves remain. Extend existing TabNav/field/LiveView suites using original TDD cases and fixtures, then update Storybook, run mix q, targeted regressions and required existing E2E. New feature E2E remains blocked by final UX approval. No existing test expectation changes planned; minimal existing browser navigation repairs must preserve assertions and intent. No mix precommit, commit, push or publish.

Original TDD red established before implementation: focused existing TabNav, streamed/file fields and Channels/SMTP LiveView suites now reproduce missing Main/Advanced navigation and accessibility, missing shared panel composition, unwanted embedded disclosures/headings, and draft/error/save journeys. Evidence /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-6-red.log. Production and existing assertions unchanged before this run.

Implementation green: 15 new original tests in existing suites; focused run 139/139 passed (/tmp/zaq-h2i-3-6-focused.log). mix q passed after sharing the presentation-only tab event helper (/tmp/zaq-h2i-3-6-q.log). Wider regression passed 773 checks (6 properties, 767 tests), including reviewed persistence and capability/resolver suites (/tmp/zaq-h2i-3-6-regression.log). Manual Chromium inspection passed ARIA/keyboard ArrowRight/Home/End activation and focus, actual inactive-panel invisibility, native FormData inclusion of inactive limits and explicit false policy, invalid Advanced save revealing its field error, credential retention, and save/reload; no page errors. Screenshots /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-6-smtp-main.png and /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-6-smtp-advanced.png. Initial inspection used pointer clicking on an existing styled switch input intercepted by its track; keyboard Space operates the existing accessible switch correctly, with no switch changes. Full existing npm test is running; only the existing native streamed-update journey navigation/selector was repaired for tabs, preserving all assertions and intent. No new feature E2E authored and no mix precommit/Git publication.

User steering: use existing DesignSystem.Toggle exactly like People, replace feature TabNav usage and remove feature-only additions, preserve composition/drafts/whole-form saves/error navigation; do not change unrelated TabNav behavior. Discovery confirms Toggle uses native type=button segments, string value/value_param and aria-pressed, with normal Tab/Shift-Tab and Enter/Space semantics; no custom arrow-key hook is needed. Plan: keep focused field presentation options and shared sections, move settings composition into a focused ConnectionSettings component using Toggle, restore TabNav/source story/tests and remove only its feature hook registration. Existing LiveView suites remain owners of persistence/draft journeys; a focused composition suite is needed because no existing module coherently owns the new container (Toggle owns selector primitives; streamed/file suites own fields). Existing selector assertions currently require tab roles/aria-selected/roving arrow/Home/End. Requested explicit approval to change those to Toggle button/aria-pressed/native keyboard expectations and transfer feature-only component cases, preserving every draft/save/error/database assertion. This approval request follows docs/testing-approach.md existing-test-behavior gate; do not infer approval from the implementation request. Earlier full npm test attempt did not reach browser tests: bootstrap failed :eaddrinuse because the owned inspection server occupied 4002. Stopped that owned server; rerun after selector change. This is distinct from the historical dashboard failure; no browser assertions or timeouts changed.

Explicit test-contract approval received from Jad in the current conversation: “Approve the described test changes.” Approved scope: replace newly introduced tablist/tab, aria-selected and roving arrow/Home/End expectations with People-style Toggle native buttons, aria-pressed, Tab/Shift-Tab and Enter/Space behavior; transfer feature-only TabNav composition tests to the focused shared container suite. Preserve all drafts, whole-form save, error navigation and reloaded-database assertions. Existing unrelated TabNav tests/behavior will be restored unchanged. Source: reply to the specific existing-test-behavior approval request, 2026-11-22.

Approved Toggle follow-up implemented with a focused ConnectionSettings presentation component reusing DesignSystem.Toggle exactly like People: string value, value_param=tab, native type=button controls and aria-pressed. Shared sections/drafts/whole-form saves/error navigation remain. TabNav source, original tests and Storybook entry, Toggle implementation, and assets/js/app.js are now identical to HEAD; no custom hook or unrelated TabNav changes remain. Approved TDD red: 13 changed-contract tests failed before replacing production markup, /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-6-toggle-red.log. Green focused 144 tests; broader 778 checks (6 properties, 772 tests), /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-6-toggle-focused.log and /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-6-toggle-regression.log. mix q passed /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-6-toggle-q.log; diff --check passed. Native keyboard browser inspection passed Tab/Shift-Tab focus, Enter/Space activation, exact two buttons, aria-pressed and active styling, actual hidden-panel visibility, retained unsaved password/limit, and no save on switching; no browser page errors. Updated screenshots /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-6-toggle-smtp-main.png and /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-6-toggle-smtp-advanced.png. UX and consolidated E2E descriptions now reflect the approved Toggle contract; final feature UX approval remains pending. Full existing npm test still running after successful bootstrap; no new feature E2E authored. No mix precommit, commit or push.

Existing native streamed-update E2E failure investigated from its trace/error-context: after an untouched file policy was serialized, Advanced acquired an error marker, so the exact selector could not find “Advanced settings”. Trace contains real “Must be a positive integer or a boolean policy” errors. Cause: browser-only _unused_send_on_file_failure (and other known file-control usage markers) reached strict domain normalization. Reuse search found streamed controls already strip their own known markers but no reusable generic helper. Added focused FileDeliverySettings.form_params/2 at the BO boundary, shared by generic/SMTP validate and save, removing only markers for rendered file inputs; omitted subtrees stay omitted and malformed/unknown real fields remain unchanged for strict validation. No domain FileSettings/adapter/capability/persistence contracts changed. Three original regressions first failed (/tmp/zaq-h2i-3-6-usage-red.log), then all 147 focused tests passed (/tmp/zaq-h2i-3-6-toggle-focused.log), including rejection leaving DB state unchanged and false-policy save after known-marker filtering. Storybook render verified HTTP 200 with Main-only/Main/Advanced/both-error variations, correct Toggle selection, hidden panels, no duplicate IDs and no page errors; /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-6-toggle-storybook.png. Existing full browser run still executing its original compiled code; final rerun needed for the fixed path. No existing assertions weakened or timeouts/retries increased.

Full existing npm test finished against the pre-usage-fix browser build: 587 passed, 3 skipped, 3 failed (native streamed-update journey in Firefox/WebKit/Chromium), log /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-6-toggle-e2e.log. All three traces confirm the same diagnosed known-framework-marker error; preserved under /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-6-usage-failure-artifacts before the next run. No unrelated browser failure occurred. Final BO usage-marker fix is already red/green covered in existing component/LiveView suites. Rebuilding and rerunning the affected existing channels and streamed_updates specs across all three browsers against final code, /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-6-final-e2e.log. This repeat is justified by the production fix; no new feature E2E or relaxed expectations/retries/timeouts.
